stdout:
usage: benham.py initiate [-h]
                          {status,threads,note,drop,close,ask,silent,sweep,reset,log}
                          ...

Claude reaching out to Tyler first. Silence is the default.

positional arguments:
  {status,threads,note,drop,close,ask,silent,sweep,reset,log}
    status              may a question go out right now, and why not
    threads             the open loops Claude is holding
    note                hold a new open loop for a later run
    drop                decide an open loop is not worth asking
    close               an open loop resolved
    ask                 send ONE question, if the gate allows it
    silent              log a run that decided to say nothing
    sweep               lapse expired questions, reconcile threads
    reset               clear the dormant state (human only)
    log                 the human-readable run log

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
